## Phosphoproteomics visualization

```{r, fig.width=2, fig.height=2}

source('../macrophage_figure_setting.R')
pca_dir <- '/Users/henrysanford/Dropbox @RU Dropbox/Vinogradova Laboratory/Vinogradova Laboratory/Henry_data processing/01_data_analysis_folders/06_macrophage/macrophage/phosphoproteomics/'

plot_loadings <- function(loadings_df, ggplot_obj, arrow_scaling, num_loadings = 5){
  loadings_df %>% arrange(PC1) %>% tail(num_loadings) %>% pull(variable)-> top_pc1
  loadings_df %>% arrange(PC1) %>% head(num_loadings) %>% pull(variable)-> bottom_pc1
  loadings_df %>% arrange(PC2) %>% tail(num_loadings) %>% pull(variable)-> top_pc2
  loadings_df %>% arrange(PC2) %>% head(num_loadings) %>% pull(variable)-> bottom_pc2
  
  loadings_df %>% filter(variable %in% c(top_pc1, bottom_pc1, bottom_pc2, top_pc2)) -> filtered_loadings
  loadings <- ggplot_obj + geom_segment(data= filtered_loadings, 
                      aes(x = 0, y = 0, 
                          xend = PC1 * arrow_scaling, 
                          yend = PC2 * arrow_scaling), 
                      inherit.aes = FALSE,
                    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm")),
                    size = LINE_WIDTH,
                    color="grey90") + 
    geom_text(data= filtered_loadings,
                    mapping = aes(label=variable,x=PC1*arrow_scaling, y=PC2*arrow_scaling), 
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, 
                    segment.size = LINE_WIDTH,
                    min.segment.length = unit(0,"mm"),
                    size=1.763, 
                    color="black",
                    #bg.color = "white",
                    segment.color = "grey") 
  return(loadings)
}

pca_plot <- function(df, loadings_df, x_column, y_column, x_lab, y_lab, fn, arrow_scaling = 100){
  df %>%
    ggplot(aes_string(
      x = x_column,
      y = y_column,
      fill = "condition"
    )) + 
    geom_point(size = POINT_SIZE,
             stroke=POINT_STROKE,
             shape=21,
             alpha=0.9,
             col="black", 
             show.legend = FALSE) + my_theme() +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=cols, name="") +
    theme(aspect.ratio=1)-> plt
  print(plt)
  save_plot(fn, height=2, width = 2)
  
  plot_loadings(loadings_df, plt, arrow_scaling) -> plot_with_loadings
  print(plot_with_loadings)
  save_plot(paste0(fn, "_with_loadings"), height=2, width = 2)
  ggplot() + my_theme() +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) + 
    theme(aspect.ratio=1) -> base_plot
  plot_loadings(loadings_df, base_plot, 1, 10) -> loadings_only
  
  print(loadings_only)
  save_plot(paste0(fn, "_loadings_only"), height=2, width = 2)
}

read.csv(paste0(pca_dir, "pca_results.csv")) -> df

read.csv(paste0(pca_dir, "loadings_results.csv")) -> loadings_df

  paste0(pca_dir, "pca"),
  arrow_scaling = 260
)
```

### GO fill-label lookup (shared MSigDB 2026.1.Hs source)

```{r}
# Single source of truth shared with go_enrich()/.go_msigdb() (see GO_updates.md):
# the MSigDB C5 GO 2026.1.Hs export. Load once; drop the large `description` column.
msigdb_go <- readr::read_csv(
  '/Users/henrysanford/Dropbox @RU Dropbox/Vinogradova Laboratory/Vinogradova Laboratory/Henry_data processing/01_data_analysis_folders/06_macrophage/macrophage/reference_dbs/msigdb_go_2026.csv',
  col_select = c(ontology, GO_id, term, gene), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Member gene SYMBOLS of one GO term (by id), or the union of several named terms.
go_genes <- function(id) msigdb_go |> dplyr::filter(GO_id == id) |> dplyr::pull(gene) |> unique()
go_genes_terms <- function(terms) msigdb_go |>
  dplyr::filter(tolower(term) %in% tolower(terms)) |> dplyr::pull(gene) |> unique()
```

# Pie chart
```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height=2}
lgnd_dimension <- 3
'/Users/henrysanford/Dropbox @RU Dropbox/Vinogradova Laboratory/Vinogradova Laboratory/Henry_data processing/01_data_analysis_folders/06_macrophage/macrophage/phosphoproteomics/structural_features.csv' %>%
  read_csv() %>%
  select(uniprot,residue, structure_group) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(location = replace_na(structure_group, "other")) %>%
  dplyr::count(structure_group) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
    csum = rev(cumsum(rev(n))),
    pos = n / 2 + dplyr::lead(csum, 1),
    pos = ifelse(is.na(pos), n / 2, pos)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = n, fill = structure_group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "black", size = LINE_WIDTH, show.legend = TRUE) + 
  my_theme() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = unname(cols)) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = pos, label = n), color = "black",, size = FONT_SIZE_MM, font = "Arial") +
  coord_polar("y") +
  theme(
    legend.key.height = unit(lgnd_dimension, "mm"), legend.key.width = unit(lgnd_dimension, "mm"), legend.key.spacing.y = unit(lgnd_dimension, "mm")
  )

save_plot(
```

```{r, fig.width=2.8, fig.height=2}
    reactivity_change = case_when(
      reactivity_change ~ "reactive cysteine",
      TRUE ~ "non reactive cysteine"
    ),
    group_label = paste0(
      phospho_type,
      " phosphosite, ",
      reactivity_change,
      " (n=",
      ave(
        seq_along(phospho_type),
        paste(phospho_type, reactivity_change),
        FUN = length
      ),
      ")"
    )

df %>%

    y = after_stat(density) * 100,
    color = group_label
  )) +
  geom_freqpoly(binwidth = histogram_bin_width,
                position = "identity",
                alpha = 0.7) +
  my_theme() +
  labs(x = "cysteine to phosphosite distance", y = "cysteine-phosphosite pairs (%)", color = NULL) +
  xlim(0, 35) + scale_color_manual(values = palette) + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_line(size = LINE_WIDTH, color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor.x  = element_line(size = LINE_WIDTH, color = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "top",

      size = FONT_SIZE,
      color = "black",
      family = FONT_FAMILY,
      margin = margin()
    ),
    legend.key.height = unit(1, "mm"),
    legend.margin = margin(b = -7)
  ) + scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      from = 0,
      by = histogram_bin_width,
      length.out = round(max_distance / histogram_bin_width)

    limits = c(0, max_distance),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  )
```

```{r}
lgnd_dimension <- 3
"phosphorylation_table.csv" %>%
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE)  %>% 
  select(residue) %>%
  # 1. Split the column by the comma and store as a list column
  mutate(
    residue = str_split(residue, pattern = ",")
  ) %>%
  
  # 2. Explode the list column into new rows
  #    The new column containing the split elements will be named 'my_column_split'
  unnest(residue) %>%
  
  # 3. Slice to just the first character of the new column
  mutate(
    first_char = str_sub(residue, start = 1, end = 1)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::count(first_char) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
    csum = rev(cumsum(rev(n))),
    pos = n / 2 + dplyr::lead(csum, 1),
    pos = ifelse(is.na(pos), n / 2, pos)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = n, fill = first_char)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "black", size = LINE_WIDTH, show.legend = TRUE) + 
  my_theme() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = (unname(cols))) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = pos, label = n), color = "black",, size = FONT_SIZE_MM, font = "Arial") +
  coord_polar("y") +
  theme(
    legend.key.height = unit(lgnd_dimension, "mm"), legend.key.width = unit(lgnd_dimension, "mm"), legend.key.spacing.y = unit(lgnd_dimension, "mm")
  )

save_plot("phosphosite_pie_chart", 1.5, 1.3)
```

### WP vs Phospho scatterplot

```{r}



correlation_cols <-
  c(
    "light_grey" = "lightgrey",
    "dark_grey" = "grey40",
    "teal" = "#21918c",
    "violet" = "#440154",
    "yellow" = "#bade28",
    'black' = 'black'
  )

create_wp_rna_corr_plot <-
  function(df ,comparison,
           proteins_to_label,
           x_lim = 4.6,
           y_lim = 10) {
    condition = strsplit(comparison, "_")[[1]][1]
    control = strsplit(comparison, "_")[[1]][2]
    
    y_lim = max(abs(df$log2FoldChange)) * 1.2
    y_min = min(df$log2FoldChange) * 1.2
    x_lim = max(abs(df$logFC_wp)) * 1.2
    print(y_lim)
    print(y_min)
    print(x_lim)
    
    df %>% filter(protein %in% proteins_to_label) -> label_data
    
    label <- df %>%
      summarise(
        left_red = sum(gene_color == 'yellow' & logFC_wp < 0),
        right_red = sum(gene_color == 'yellow' & logFC_wp > 0),
        left_cyan = sum(gene_color == 'teal' & logFC_wp < 0),
        right_cyan = sum(gene_color == 'teal' & logFC_wp > 0),
        left_yellow = sum(gene_color == 'dark_grey' & logFC_wp < 0),
        right_yellow = sum(gene_color == 'dark_grey' & logFC_wp > 0),
        down_blue = sum(gene_color == 'violet' & log2FoldChange < 0),
        up_blue = sum(gene_color == 'violet' & log2FoldChange > 0),
        grey = sum(gene_color == 'light_grey')
      ) %>% unlist()
    
    x_lbl_sprd = x_lim * 0.915
    y_lbl_sprd = y_lim * 0.98
    y_lbl_min = y_min * 0.98
    lbl_alpha = 1
    
    
    x <-
      c(-x_lbl_sprd,
        x_lbl_sprd,
        -x_lbl_sprd,
        x_lbl_sprd,
        -x_lbl_sprd,
        x_lbl_sprd,
        0,
        0,
        0)
    y <-
      c(0,
        0,
        y_lbl_sprd,
        y_lbl_min,
        y_lbl_min,
        y_lbl_sprd,
        y_lbl_min,
        y_lbl_sprd,
        0)
    alpha <- c(rep(lbl_alpha, 8), 0)
    color <-
      c(
        'yellow',
        'yellow',
        'teal',
        'teal',
        'dark_grey',
        'dark_grey',
        'violet',
        'violet',
        'black'
      )
    text_labels <- data.frame(x, y, label, color)
    ratio <- paste0("(", condition, "/", control, ")")
    pearson_r_color <- 'grey40'
    df %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = logFC_wp, y = log2FoldChange)) +
      geom_point(
        alpha = 0.2,
        size = 1,
        mapping = aes(fill = gene_color),
        shape = 21,
        stroke = 0
      ) +
      geom_smooth(
        method = "lm",
        se = FALSE,
        color = pearson_r_color,
        formula = 'y ~ x',
        size = LINE_WIDTH * 4
      ) +
      labs(x = substitute(paste('protein expression, log'[2], n), list(n = ratio)),
           y = substitute(paste('phosphorylation, log'[2], n), list(n = ratio))) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = c(FC_CUTOFF,-FC_CUTOFF),
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = LINE_WIDTH
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = c(FC_CUTOFF,-FC_CUTOFF),
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = LINE_WIDTH
      ) +
      theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.position = "none") +
      
      # specific proteins
      geom_point(
        mapping = aes(fill = gene_color),
        alpha = 1,
        data = label_data,
        size = 1,
        shape = 21,
        color = "black",
        stroke = POINT_STROKE / 2
      ) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = label_data,
        mapping = aes(label = protein, color = gene_color),
        size = FONT_SIZE_MM,
        segment.color = "black",
        segment.size = LINE_WIDTH,
        min.segment.length = 0.2,
        #bg.color = "white",
        box.padding = 1,
        direction = "both"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = correlation_cols) +
      my_theme() +
      theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
            legend.position = "none") +
      geom_label(
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        data = text_labels,
        mapping = aes(
          x = x,
          y = y,
          label = label,
          fill = color,
          alpha = alpha
        ),
        color = 'white',
        size = 6,
        label.size = 0,
        size.unit = "pt"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = correlation_cols) +
      ylim(y_min, y_lim) +
      xlim(-x_lim, x_lim) +
      stat_cor(
        aes(label = ..r.label..),
        color = pearson_r_color,
        label.x = -(x_lim * 0.95),
        label.y = (y_lim * 0.67),
        size = FONT_SIZE_MM
      ) -> plot
    # Rasterize only the dense point cloud; labels/lines/axes stay vector.
    plot <- ggrastr::rasterise(plot, layers = "Point", dpi = 600, dev = "ragg")
    print(plot)
    
    save_plot(
     paste0(
        correlation_dir,
        condition,
        "_",
        control,
        "_pearson_corrplot"
      ),
      height = 2,
      width = 2
    )
  }
```

```{r}
# clusterProfiler / org.Hs.eg.db / dplyr are loaded by macrophage_figure_setting.R
# (sourced at the top), with the GO-enrichment engine go_enrich().

# Your dataframe: df
# Columns: log2_FC, -log10_pval, protein, residue

# Define p-value cutoff
p_cut <- -log10(0.05)

# 1. Filter upregulated phosphosites
up_sites <- df %>%
  filter(log2_FC > 1, `-log10_pval` > p_cut)

# 2. Filter downregulated phosphosites
down_sites <- df %>%
  filter(log2_FC < -1, `-log10_pval` > p_cut)

# 3. Extract unique proteins
up_proteins <- unique(up_sites$protein)
down_proteins <- unique(down_sites$protein)

# GO BP over-representation via the shared engine (go_enrich() in
# macrophage_figure_setting.R: clusterProfiler::enricher on MSigDB 2026 GO, propagated,
# with simplify() redundancy reduction). Background = NULL (all annotated genes),
# matching the original enrichGO default universe.
go_bp_phospho <- bind_rows(
  go_enrich(up_proteins,   ont = "BP", background = NULL, simplify_cutoff = 0.6) |> mutate(direction = "Upregulated"),
  go_enrich(down_proteins, ont = "BP", background = NULL, simplify_cutoff = 0.6) |> mutate(direction = "Downregulated")
)
write_csv(go_bp_phospho, "go_bp_phospho.csv")
```

```{r}
# Reactivity proteins (those with a significant reactivity change) and the measured

  unique()
```
